    Generate Markdown report's body

    dot-markdown_report_body.Rd

    Generate Markdown report's body

    .markdown_report_body(
  report_contents,
  overview_tbl,
  safe_people_tbl,
  safe_project_tbl,
  safe_data_tbl,
  safe_user_perm_tbl,
  safe_setting_tbl,
  safe_output_tbl,
  break_by = NULL
)

    Arguments

    report_contents

    String with Markdown report (e.g., header).

    overview_tbl

    Data frame with overview details for the RO-Crate.

    safe_people_tbl

    Data frame with Safe People details.

    safe_project_tbl

    Data frame with Safe Project details.

    safe_data_tbl

    Data frame with Safe Data details.

    safe_user_perm_tbl

    Data frame with Safe Data user permissions.

    safe_setting_tbl

    Data frame with Safe Setting details.

    safe_output_tbl

    Data frame with Safe Output details.

    break_by

    Optional string with variable to be used for breaking down each table (e.g., server), as opposed to display all the results in a single table.

    Value

    String with updated Markdown report.
